scope.summary: Versioned per-issue delivery evidence, trusted managed-file protection and conservative scheduled reconciliation for canonical GitHub Issues.
implemented: Versioned evidence schema with paired Markdown checksum, strict validation and isolated attempts.
CI validation for canonical issue criteria, changed files, managed archives/status, renamed files and audited exceptions.
Protected-branch scheduled reconciliation with verified merge/check status, canonical issue owner approval, serialization and recovery.

criteria.description: New evidence schema + validator + examples and tests.

evidence.outcome: Version 1 schema; strict validator and checksummed Markdown example are included.

criteria.description: Verified scoped-file CI enforcement protects shared archives/status files.

evidence.outcome: Verify runs PR evidence and managed-file checks.
Protected files, exact-head exceptions and renamed managed files are covered.

criteria.description: Deterministic GitHub Issues-first post-merge single-writer reconciliation with missed-event recovery.

evidence.outcome: Serialized scheduled full reconciliation runs from copilot/Development and does not cancel in-progress runs.
Concurrent/out-of-order merges, retries and idempotent recovery are covered with synthetic API fixtures.

criteria.description: Full story not closed from a partial PR; merged/CI/accepted statuses distinguished.

evidence.outcome: Partial and documentation-only evidence remains unaccepted; the writer never closes or reopens issues.
Issue comments distinguish merge, actual required CI, evidence validity and human acceptance.

criteria.description: Parallel merge, failure/retry, idempotency and tampering fixtures pass.

evidence.outcome: 11 passed, 0 failed; includes concurrent/out-of-order, duplicate, retry, tampering and missing-CI cases.

criteria.description: Confirm actual `verify` and `database` gates; never weaken branch protection.

evidence.outcome: Existing verify and database jobs remain enabled and unchanged apart from verify-side checks.
Merged PR #141 run reported verify and database successful; copilot/Development reports protected.

tests.result: Changed tool modules passed Node syntax checks.
Validated 2 delivery evidence files after adding this attempt pair.

decisions: GitHub Issues remain the live work and acceptance record; historical archives are not edited.
Issue #142 component reservations and dispatch coordination remain out of scope.
Reconciliation only appends a verified audit comment and never closes or reopens an issue.

reruns.outcome: Run 43182536515 failed at canonical issue metadata validation; a new run is required for the completed PR head.

reruns.outcome: Cancelled after the newer commit; no CI result was accepted.

limitations: No live GitHub issue write was performed; API behavior is covered with synthetic fixtures and the scheduled writer begins after merge.
The branch reports protected, but the exact required-check ruleset was not readable through the available repository API.
Owner approval of the canonical issue association on the exact final PR head is required before reconciliation.
